banner.where: mobile/lib/features/report/report_screen.dart:202 (inline, end of the car report below Sources)

interstitial.why: No AglAds.onTransition() call in mobile/lib (grep: none); the tab-switch interstitial left with the tab bar (spec CarDeal.md:209). Keep it absent: a car check is a focused read of one report, and the spec already leaves any new interstitial to founder Q2 (CarDeal.md:381).

native.why: This is a genuine scrolling feed of public content items: the newest NHTSA owner complaints for the car, up to 200 (mobile/lib/services/complaint_digest.dart:39 keepNewest = 200; :84-99), filterable and searchable (complaint_list_screen.dart:12-13,47-109). A small template as its own row after every 8th complaint fits; it must stay visibly an ad (Google template badge) and never inside the report itself (the report keeps its single banner). Implementation note: itemCount must grow by shown.length ~/ 8 and the index mapping must skip ad rows; render nothing when the filtered list has fewer than 8 items. Not a finance/health screen: complaints are public federal records.

rewarded.existing_limit_or_quota: none. Only a design cap: mobile/lib/features/compare/compare_screen.dart:121 maxCars = 4 (side-by-side layout limit)
rewarded.why: CarDeal is free with no account, no paid tier and no upsell by design (spec CarDeal.md:79). There is no existing free quota to extend; the only cap is the 4-column Compare layout (compare_screen.dart:121), which is a layout limit - selling a 5th column for an ad would invent a limit. No IAP in pubspec.

blockers: pubspec.lock pins agl_ads at 97e9a7f (mobile/pubspec.lock) (pubspec.lock grep), which predates cb21ee5 and has no ad_native.dart (git cat-file checked) - developer must run `flutter pub upgrade agl_ads` before AglNativeAd/showRewarded exist
